reviews.comment: Took the design class with her and it was a great experience - sometimes the labs and out of class work was a lot to balance with other classes. But for a two credit hour class I learned a lot and genuinely enjoyed Professor Lagoudas.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: When going to her for questions she would say that our group was doing fine, then one day she says that our whole project is not good enough and that she knows we could do better. We had a chance to fix the problems but it was very close to the end of the semester.

I enjoyed Mrs. Lagoudas. ENGR 270 was a easy in my own opinion, but I know other groups struggled in some areas. For this class, groups are assigned solely based on everyone's availability outside of class. Some assignments had unclear instructions. She expects you to know when things are due because she often won't  remind the class.
